description.purpose: Establish premium long-haul wide-body international routes focused on high-density service to major global airports.
advantages: Capable of handling 350 passengers in a standard three-class configuration
Efficient fuel usage for aircraft size at 19 lbs/km
disadvantages: Requires long 11,000 ft runway due to aircraft size and weight for a twin engine
Limited airport compatibility compared to a smaller aircraft
High operational cost due to GE90-115B engines and aircraft size
High A-Check maintenance cost of approximately $5,000,000
